name: B10-0558/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is responding to a petition signed by 1.2 million citizens asking the EU to help people who cannot get a safe abortion. The Parliament asks the European Commission to propose a fund that would pay back countries which choose to provide abortion care to anyone in the EU who lacks access. Countries would join voluntarily, and national laws would stay as they are.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose a voluntary EU funding scheme for abortion care.
- **Who it affects:** People in the EU who cannot get a safe abortion, especially in Poland and Malta.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to make a legal proposal; Parliament also wants abortion added to the EU rights charter.
